pageObservations.observation: Title Sáng mai mình học ở trường, all four goals and warmup instruction match the complete original page. No Vietnamese glosses printed on photo/word options. This original boundary page was already viewed in L8 review and manually compared to all nine L9 records.

Complete text1 scene, 4 ZH/VI turns, five raw word/pinyin/gloss/POS rows match; 边 retains bian/biān and htố./dt., 家 retains four physical lines and lượng. Two Tiểu Ngữ helps and their labels match, including first explanation ending danh từ thì đọc biān and oral nèige. Role and pair instructions complete.

Both entire grammar explanations and their titles/read instructions match. Time/place grammar title wraps after nơi chốn; existential explanation has all three physical VI lines. Chinese examples and completion tasks have no VI invented. Text2 scene and listen instruction lead into PDF80/81.

Seven word rows 6–12 and raw pinyin/POS match, including 上 shang/shàng and 第 ttố.; whole multiline tip about 上 matches. Four Chinese dialogue turns are anchor sources for Vietnamese on 81, not missing translations on this page. Role/question instructions and both translated reading questions match. Listening options are Chinese only.

All four text2 Vietnamese turns are complete and correctly paired to PDF80 speakers and Chinese, including complete two-line second turn. Full ordinal grammar title/explanation and cụm từ read instruction match. Text3 scene has correct 王一雪 and 杨同乐 / Vương Nhất Tuyết and Dương Đồng Lạc and both physical lines; listen instruction correct.

Eleven word rows13–23 match every gloss/POS/pinyin; 和 is giới. and television ti vi, vô tuyến. Complete six-turn text3 translation and roles match; em/chị corresponds to the printed characters and conversation, đấy correctly retained on last turn. 玩儿 tip/label and two reading questions and all instructions match.

All four Vietnamese units match: lesson label, combined-exercise heading, fill-blank instruction and whole two-line picture-description instruction. Blank options/stems and image descriptions are Chinese only; no missing printed Vietnamese.

Whole classroom role-play instruction, chapter activity name and all shared lesson7–9 study-summary headings, introduction, labels and column headers match. First of ten summary language rows complete; summary continues physically on85 and is explicitly shared, not assigned solely to lesson9.

Whole table continuation with nine remaining summary language rows matches. Final mixed ZH/VI row is physically split after 第, so empty lineJoiner is required to reconstruct 第一个学生 without a false internal space. All quoted grammar words and Chinese example text retained exactly. Closing improvement heading and running lesson label present.
